label: Agent Communication
title: Agent Communication
subtitle: Lets agents send messages to each other — either fire-and-forget (Talk) or as a question that waits for an answer (Ask). This is how agents consult each other without going through the main conversation.
whenToUse: Use Talk to pass information to another agent asynchronously. Use Ask when an agent needs an answer before it can continue — for example, checking with a domain expert before proceeding.

methods.name: Talk to Agent
methods.description: Sends a message to another agent without waiting for a reply. Non-blocking.

methods.name: Ask Agent
methods.description: Sends a question to another agent and waits for the reply before continuing. Blocking.

mediaCaption: An Ask Agent action card showing the target agent name, the question sent, and the reply received
tips: Talk is much cheaper than Delegate — use it when you just need to inform another agent, not hand off a full task.
